finding: KSU's note 8 attributes its Arabic-language explanation and poem for wa-nhar to al-Farra's Ma'ani al-Qur'an (cited p. 377). A readable IslamWeb copy titled Ma'ani al-Qur'an li'l-Farra, volume 3, printed page 296, reproduces the relevant explanation: facing the qibla with one's chest, the Arabic usage manaziluna tatanahar, and the Banu Asad poem. This corroborates the source-text attribution at the passage level, but the page number differs (377 vs 296) and the poem opening differs in the returned witnesses (KSU note: هل أنت; IslamWeb: ها أنت). Without matching the same print/edition, neither discrepancy should be silently normalized and this does not identify KSU/legacy source ID 310's Tabari edition.
